verdict.rationale: Cooley is a law firm. Its offerings are legal services, free Cooley GO document generators and guidance content, and Cooley AI, which the evidence describes as serving the firm's own lawyers. None of these is a developer platform with separate test and production data environments, so a sandbox for testing is a category error for this kind of product. Probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI or API surface, and nothing in the evidence suggests any developer-facing environment.
